hook: Snapchat drug ring claimed *800-900* Hyderabad buyers
hook_b: Snapchat drug ring claimed *800-900* Hyderabad buyers
tldr: Telangana's EAGLE Force arrested three men near Manikonda on Nov 15 and seized 1.24 kg of ganja and 16.59 g of OG Kush. Police say the gang took orders on Snapchat, paid suppliers in crypto and delivered 5-gram sachets around the city.

beats.what: The Hyderabad Narcotics Police Station of EAGLE Force intercepted a car heading from Lanco Hills to Manikonda and seized drugs, three phones and the car.
beats.why: Police say the accused ran Snapchat accounts to take orders and opened a new one after the first was blocked; the Mumbai-based main supplier is absconding.
beats.care: Police say the network sold through social media to hundreds of local users, many young.

causes.label: Tip-off on a car near Lanco Hills

cards.body: The Hindu (Nov 18): drugs came from Mumbai by bus and were repacked into ~5 g sachets for delivery across Hyderabad.

viz.verdict: Social media + crypto used to sell drugs locally
